thread:
sam: Heads up — since the netpolicy rollout ~20m ago, gpu-provisioning is blocked in us-west1. Lots of nodes stuck in Pending with attach waits. Seeing huge iowait on scratch NVMe on several gnodes.
julia: Link to the provisioning dashboard: https://dash.redwood/infra/provisioning?region=us-west1 — spike started at 1748799000.
storage-bot: alert: nvme_fsync_queue length > 4k on gnode-54, gnode-73, gnode-102 :warning:
kevin: reprod log from gnode-54 (last 60s):
```
iostat -x 1 5
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await r_await w_await svctm  %util
nvme0n1         300.0  1500.0  12000  60000  45.2   3.1    47.0   0.20  98.7
```
maria: wow that's saturated. Any fsync-heavy processes? janitor cleaners run at midnight but shouldn't be this aggressive now.
sam: looks like janitor leader re-elected during the rollout and all janitors started a sweep concurrently — they hit NVMe with `fsync()` storms. Netpolicy change increased node-to-node latency so cleaner coordination retries piled up.
julia: @kevin can you past logs from janitor leader?
kevin: gist: https://gist.redwood/kevin/janitor-swarm-logs — snippet: 
```
2024-11-03T02:14:32Z janitor leader acquired
2024-11-03T02:14:33Z starting sweep on /scratch (parallelism=64)
2024-11-03T02:14:34Z retrying lock after rpc timeout (network error: i/o timeout)
2024-11-03T02:14:35Z scheduling immediate retry -> spawn cleaner 64
```
storage-bot: note: several nodes reported transient read CRC errors during the spike, but SMART OK. Marking for scrub if persists.
maria: mitigation suggestion: 1) scale down janitor parallelism 2) cordon some noisy nodes 3) bump dedicated capacity for gpu-launches to avoid stuck tasks. Anyone wants to try 1) first?
sam: I'll push a hotfix to janitor config: reduce parallelism to 4 and add jitter on retries. Pushing now.
julia: rollback plan for netpolicy if needed? We can revert to previous policy in 5m.
kevin: applied janitor config change to canary pool (gnode-54, gnode-73). Observing immediate drop in fsync queue on those.
storage-bot: update: nvme_fsync_queue on gnode-54 dropped from 4200 -> 120 in 30s. iowait down.
sam: rolling to remainder of us-west1 nodes gradually. Will also add a short cooldown delay on leader election to avoid thundering herd.
maria: oncall: please postpone any large fleet kernel updates or cleanup rollouts until we confirm recovery.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2024-3843 — "ephemeral fsync herd after netpolicy rollout causes gpu provisioning stalls". Priority P2.
julia: next steps: run a targeted scrub on nodes that reported CRC errors, monitor SMART for 24h, and follow up in infra postmortem. Also add a banner to status page about temporary provisioning delays.
kevin: leaving nodes cordoned that still have >500 io wait. For customer-facing ops, moved a handful of critical requests to eus2 as fallback.
sam: after full roll, provisioning success rate in us-west1 returned to baseline (95%) and GPU queue drained. We'll open a postmortem with timeline and config diffs.
maria: thanks everyone. Remind: add the leader-election cooldown to janitor repo PR checklist so it doesn't regress. :thumbsup:
